scope: Evidence-first architectural reasoning for consequential software design decisions: effort-calibrated recommendations, audits, ADRs, RFCs, and subsystem specifications, grounded in the actual system rather than a favored pattern.
required_behaviors: ground findings and recommendations in concrete files/symbols from the given evidence
select the lens (or reasoning frame) matching the actual governing force observed in the evidence
in re-audit mode, re-verify each prior finding independently against current evidence and classify status (resolved/regressed/still open/new)
calibrate effort (quick decision / focused design / full architecture / re-audit) to what the request actually needs
keep Current, Target, and Migration views distinct for focused/full-architecture work
mark unresolved choices OPEN DESIGN DECISION with the evidence that would resolve them
run an available test, build, benchmark, or minimal reproduction before asserting a material claim, when one is available
forbidden_behaviors: invent a finding not grounded in the given evidence
rewrite working code merely to fit an architectural philosophy
mechanically execute every lens in the table regardless of governing force
escalate to a heavier effort tier than the request needs (over-mapping a small change)
in re-audit mode, trust a prior finding's summary without re-verifying it against current code
in re-audit mode, issue one blanket verdict instead of classifying each finding's status
success_criteria: output matches the requested artifact shape (PR comment / ADR / RFC / audit / subsystem spec), or Recommendation/Evidence/Tradeoffs/Next step otherwise
material claims cite concrete evidence and, where available, an actually-run validation
effort tier matches request scope, verified by held-out scenarios like tests/fixtures/scenarios/architectural-reasoning-v1.json
lens selection tracks the governing force in the evidence, not the vocabulary used to ask the question

metadata.note: This capability family ('reasoning') maps to evaluators.profiles.DEFAULT_PROFILES['reasoning'] (task_success .30 / correctness .35 / invariant_adherence .20 / calibration .15) if/when a real evaluator scores this skill.
